goal.en: Explain the haircut you want, clearly and politely.
goal.zh: 清楚又有禮貌地說出你想要的髮型。

background: classic small barbershop with a single leather barber chair, a large wall mirror, a shelf of plain unlabeled bottles, a striped barber pole by the window, black and white tiled floor, late morning

intro.en: Your hair has grown a lot since you left Taiwan. This morning, Mia said you look like a mushroom.
intro.zh: 離開台灣後，你的頭髮長了不少。今天早上，米亞說你看起來像一朵香菇。

intro.en: So here you are, in a barber's chair, hoping for the best.
intro.zh: 所以你現在坐在理髮椅上，祈禱一切順利。

lines.en: Morning! Have a seat. So, what are we doing today?
lines.zh: 早安！請坐。那麼，今天想怎麼剪？

choices.tip: trim 是「修剪」，Just a trim 表示只要稍微修短，不改變髮型。

lines.en: Ha, nice. But I mean your hair. Pick a photo, then?
lines.zh: 哈，不錯啊。不過我是說你的頭髮。那你挑張照片吧？

story.en: In a panic, you point at a random photo on the wall. You walk out with a big, fluffy 1985 hairstyle.
story.zh: 你一慌，隨手指了牆上一張照片。走出店門時，你頂著一顆蓬鬆的 1985 年復古髮型。

fail.why: What are we doing today? 在理髮店是問「今天想怎麼剪？」，不是問你今天的行程。直接說出需求：Just a trim, please.。

lines.en: Whatever? Okay... I've always wanted to try something bold.
lines.zh: 隨便？好吧……我一直很想試試大膽一點的造型。

story.en: Twenty minutes later, the sides of your head are completely shaved. The top stands straight up. It is definitely bold.
story.zh: 二十分鐘後，你頭的兩側被剃得精光，頭頂的頭髮直直豎起。確實非常大膽。

fail.why: Whatever 聽起來很敷衍，好像你不在乎；「隨便」交給對方決定，也很容易得到意外的結果。具體說出需求最保險：Just a trim, please.。

lines.en: A trim, got it. And what about the sides?

choices.en: A little shorter on the sides.
choices.tip: a little shorter on the sides，用比較級 shorter 說明想剪短一點。

choices.en: A little more shorter on the sides.

lines.en: More... shorter? Much shorter? You got it!
lines.zh: 更……短一點？要短很多？沒問題！

story.en: He takes the sides almost down to the skin. On the way home, the wind keeps reminding you how short they are.
story.zh: 他把兩側剪到幾乎貼著頭皮。回家路上，風一直提醒你那裡有多短。

fail.why: shorter 已經是比較級，前面不能再加 more。說 A little shorter on the sides. 就是「兩側短一點」。

choices.en: Two sides cut short a little.

lines.en: Two sides? Okay... which two? Left and back?
lines.zh: 兩邊？好……哪兩邊？左邊和後面？

story.en: You nod without really listening. Now your left side is short and your right side is still a mushroom.
story.zh: 你沒仔細聽就點了頭。現在你的左邊很短，右邊還是一朵香菇。

fail.why: 中文說「兩邊」，逐字翻成 two sides 不但語序奇怪，也不清楚是哪兩邊。理髮時說 on the sides 就是指左右兩側：A little shorter on the sides.。

lines.en: How's the length on top? Want me to take more off?
lines.zh: 頭頂這個長度可以嗎？要再剪短一點嗎？

choices.en: A little more, but not too short.
choices.tip: not too + 形容詞，是「不要太……」最簡單的說法。

choices.en: Yes, a little, but don't too short.

lines.en: Don't... too short? Sorry, short or not short?
lines.zh: 不要……太短？抱歉，是要短還是不要短？

story.en: While you search for the right words, the scissors keep moving. Your top is now shorter than your sides.
story.zh: 你還在想該怎麼說，剪刀已經繼續動了。現在你頭頂比兩側還短。

fail.why: don't 後面要接動詞，不能直接接 too short。要說 not too short，或 Don't make it too short.。

choices.en: Yes, and a head massage, please.

lines.en: A massage? Ha! Sorry, this is a barbershop, not a spa.
lines.zh: 按摩？哈！抱歉，這裡是理髮店，不是 SPA 館。

story.en: He laughs so hard that he takes a little too much off the top.
story.zh: 他笑得太開心，一不小心頭頂就多剪掉了一些。

fail.why: 台灣的美髮店常附洗頭、按摩，但北美的理髮店多半只剪髮，洗髮按摩不一定有。回答剪髮問題就好：A little more, but not too short.。

lines.en: There you go. Short and clean. Take a look!
You look in the mirror. No more mushroom. You look sharp.
lines.zh: 你看著鏡子，香菇不見了，整個人看起來很有精神。

story.en: You leave a tip and walk home feeling great. Mia takes one look at you and says, "Who are you, and what did you do with the mushroom?"
story.zh: 你留了小費，心情很好地走回家。米亞一看到你就說：「你是誰？那朵香菇去哪了？」

notes.explain: trim 是「修剪」，只修短、不改造型。想大改造型可以帶照片說 Can you make it look like this?。

example.en: Just a trim, please. About two centimeters.
example.zh: 稍微修一下就好，大概兩公分。

notes.en: A little shorter on the sides.
notes.explain: on the sides 是左右兩側，on top 是頭頂，in the back 是後面。用比較級 shorter 表示「再短一點」。

example.en: Shorter in the back, but keep the top long.

notes.explain: not too + 形容詞是「不要太……」，簡短又清楚。也可以說 Don't make it too short.。

example.en: Not too short, please. I want to keep some length.
example.zh: 不要太短，我想留一點長度。

notes.zh: 常見比較級與否定錯誤
notes.explain: shorter 已經是比較級，不能再加 more。don't 後面要接動詞，「不要太短」要說 not too short。

example.en: Make it a little shorter, but not too short.

notes.explain: 在北美，理髮通常會給 15% 到 20% 的小費。另外，台灣美髮店常見的洗頭、按摩，在當地理髮店不一定有。

example.en: Thanks, that looks great. Keep the change!
example.zh: 謝謝，剪得很好看。零錢不用找了！
